note: Quiet Woods (formerly Green River Stables), 592 Robin Rd, Campbellsville, about a mile from Green River Lake on 17 wooded acres bordering 30+ miles of equestrian, hiking and biking trails. Built around horse camping: horses stay in stalls in a barn beside the site rows, and the RV sites are shared by horse and non-horse campers. Any size rig. Summer weekends are partly sold as a seasonal package. --Claude
summary: Private horse-oriented campground, year-round, $45/night (all sites W/E/S), monthly $700, seasonal 18-weekend package. Google 4.5 / 114. Price passes; no gateway. HORSE SEPARATION is the question: horses are stalled in a barn, but the RV sites are the horse campers' sites with no separate general loop.
